identity: I volunteered for the Exodii to give me these implants, but don't worry, there's still a red white and blue American in this shell, ready to serve science and humanity.

identity: Yes, it's done.  Don't waste time thinking about what's different.  You're still there, just inside a tough steel case.  It won't be easy to adapt, but keep a stiff upper lip - or be brave - as you might say.  Try to keep everything intact, but if you get any damage, come back here.  Venn'll do repairs in exchange for materials.

identity: Splendid!  With it, we will be one step closer of breaking the vampires' monopoly on agelessness!  Bring it here, and I'll prepare it for Leonard.  This rejuvenation will be very beneficial to his health and ability to flee this place alongside us if vampires or something else wreck it down.
